### What's new

- Added the Weeklies planner with a guided activity picker, search, progress dashboard, individual completion controls, and All Done tracking.
- Weeklies automatically clear at their own reset and support configurable 1-3 day desktop reminders.
- Added red taskbar and tray attention for unfinished weeklies, responsive Weeklies navigation, clearer countdowns, and unique activity title colours.
- Added update-safe Weeklies state and durable coupon redemption history so selections survive application updates.
